sections.heading: What is trending: “chat gpt ai”
paragraphs: “chat gpt ai” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for ID (snapshot taken 2026-08-11T16:12:27+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 200 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

list: “NUS students to get ChatGPT access; AI module compulsory for incoming freshmen” — CNA
“National University of Singapore, OpenAI expand AI collaboration, to give all students, staff access to ChatGPT, Codex” — TNGlobal

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Tue, 11 Aug 2026 07:40:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-08-11T16:12:27+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-08-11T16:13:17+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
